title: Harry Turner's 1971 Australian intelligence document on US UFO and anti-gravity research
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Harry Turner's 1971 Australian intelligence document on US UFO and anti-gravity research, about 1952-1971 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's actually this 1971 document that came out of Australia from The Joint intelligence organization by their head of their nulear division named Harry Turner
there's this 1971 Australian document actually that grush sites a lot that is this guy I think it's the head of their nuclear division this guy Harry turner
tellings.difference: Says David Grusch cites the document a lot, and the teller is unsure that Turner headed the nuclear division.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1971 Harry Turner document from Australia's Joint Intelligence Organisation on US anti-gravity research, naming Teller and Oppenheimer.

as_told.title: 1971 Australian Harry Turner document naming Teller and Oppenheimer in anti-gravity research

tellings.quote: from a 1971 Australian intelligence document written by the head of their nuclear division Harry Turner Oppenheimer was deeply involved in exotic anti-gravity research
tellings.difference: Stresses that Oppenheimer was deeply involved in exotic anti-gravity research.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the 1971 Australian intelligence document by Harry Turner, head of the nuclear division, about US UFO and anti-gravity research involving Oppenheimer.

as_told.title: Harry Turner document on Oppenheimer anti-gravity research

tellings.quote: Turner suggested in a 1971 document that the Australian government invest more time and effort in UFO research
tellings.difference: Stresses that Turner urged the Australian government to invest more in UFO research.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Harry Turner's 1971 Australian document on UFO research.

as_told.title: Harry Turner's 1971 document urging Australian UFO research

tellings.quote: And he in 1972 wrote an extraordinary paper
tellings.difference: Dates the report 1972 instead of 1971 and says it covers US crash retrievals and a UFO flying squad.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Harry Turner's Australian JIO intelligence report on US UFO research.

as_told.title: Harry Turner's 1972 JIO report on US retrievals and a UFO flying squad

tellings.quote: It talks about crash retrievals. It confirms all these things that you have to kind of do deep research in the US to even know, which is Blue Book is fake.
tellings.difference: Adds that the document calls Blue Book a PR job and names CIA OSI outposts, including UNC Chapel Hill, plus Dyson and Townsend Brown.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same Turner JIO document, here described for what it says about Blue Book, anti-gravity work and the scientists involved.

as_told.title: Turner document: Blue Book a PR job, anti-gravity work and CIA OSI outposts
as_told.place_text: USA; University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

tellings.quote: There's this 1971 Australian document that I became aware of where the Australian intelligence officer Harry do you remember
tellings.difference: Told by Eric Weinstein, who also credits Arnowitt and Deser.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Harry Turner's 1971 Australian intelligence document on US gravity and UFO research.

as_told.title: 1971 Australian document on US gravity research
